citations.C1: Missing key (`r['price']`/`r['qty']` KeyError) — use `.get()` with default or validate schema upfront.
citations.C2: Price/qty as `None` (null in CSV) — guard against `NoneType` before cast.
citations.C3: Missing/empty string value ('' fails `float()`/`int()`) — skip or default to 0 on empty.
citations.C4: Non-numeric garbage (`"N/A"`, `"$5"`, currency symbols/commas) — sanitize/strip before cast
citations.C5: Qty as float string (`"2.5"`) — `int()` raises; use `int(float(x))` or reject non-integer quantities deliberately.
citations.C6: Float precision drift accumulating over many rows — use `Decimal` for currency instead of `float`.
citations.C7: Negative price or qty (refunds vs. bad data indistinguishable) — decide policy and validate sign explicitly.
citations.C8: Scientific notation or `inf`/`nan` strings (`float("nan")`, `float("inf")` succeed silently) — explicitly reject non-finite floats.
citations.C9: One bad row aborts the entire aggregation (no partial result, no visibility into which row) — wrap per-row parse in try/except, collect errors, continue.
